Search finds anything in the show: an LK, a Veam, a universe, a location or a node. Click Search, or press command K.
Type a few letters, and the results appear at once. Press enter to open one.
Every change can be undone. The history lists what you did in plain words, so you can go back to a moment before a mistake.
Save writes the project to a file. PatchLab also keeps back-ups, and recovers your work after a crash.
Help opens the manual for the page you are on, with these videos. And Request sends a wish or a bug to the developer.
